technical.summary: Mixed short-term bullish signals (RSI, Supertrend, Hull) conflict with bearish MACD, weak trend structure (ADX 19.4), overbought conditions, and price below key moving averages—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (384.96) with flat yield curve and negative macro score create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 58 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.
